nodes.label: TriggerContext

nodes.label: POST /v1/reply
nodes.rationale: Endpoint for the bot to respond to simulated merchant/customer replies.

nodes.label: POST /v1/tick
nodes.rationale: Periodic wake-up call where the bot decides to initiate proactive messages.

nodes.label: Judge Harness

nodes.label: Vera (Merchant AI Assistant)

nodes.label: 4-Context Composition Framework

nodes.label: Aryan Client
